units.source_text: 这天晚上没有下雪，落了一阵冰雹后，又下起雨来了。

en.t: That night it did not snow; after a spell of hail, it began to rain again.

units.source_text: 回去的前一晚，明月皎洁，天气冷飕飕的。

en.t: On the night before he was to leave, the moon was bright and the air was piercingly cold.

units.source_text: 岛村再次把驹子唤来，虽然已快到十一点了，

en.t: Shimamura called Komako to him again, though it was already nearly eleven o'clock,

units.source_text: 驹子还说要去散步，怎么劝说也不听。

en.t: Komako still said she wanted to go for a walk and would not listen no matter how he tried to dissuade her.

units.source_text: 她带着几分粗暴，将他从被炉里拖起来，硬要把他拽出去。

en.t: With a certain roughness, she dragged him up from the kotatsu and insisted on pulling him outside.
